resources.name: Experimental step-size distributions for dextran on homogeneous PS and PS-hexagonal surfaces (digitized from paper Figure 3)

access.notes: Two CSV files: exp_step_size_homogeneous_ps.csv and exp_step_size_ps_hexagonal.csv, columns: displacement_nm, probability. Provided in task resources directory (e.g., /app/resources/).

resources.notes: Used only for calibration; the final scored simulated distributions must be produced by the agent's KMC simulation.
